skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-google-ads-conversion-tracking
skill.description: Set up or troubleshoot server-side Google Ads purchase tracking for a Cloudflare storefront through Product Metrics. Review account connections, consent settings, secondary conversion actions, and test purchase receipt.
skill.summary: Configure and verify server-side Google Ads purchase tracking on Cloudflare through Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The review found no system reconnaissance or executable backtick expressions, but confirmed risks from unpinned installation and access to sensitive order details. The setup also lacks clear safeguards for permission grants, browser handoffs, and integration writes. No evidence of prompt injection in the reviewed files or intentional credential exfiltration was found.

remediation.suggestion: List and explain the minimum required permissions, verify the selected account and zone, and stop if the grant includes unexpected access.
Validate browser URLs against approved HTTPS origins for the current step. Use a known provider entry point when validation fails.

remediation.issue: Integration writes without a separate approval step
remediation.suggestion: Preview each write, including its target account, affected settings, and data destinations. Require approval before applying it and verify the result afterward.

remediation.issue: Setup instructions exceed the requested integration scope
remediation.suggestion: Keep other ad channels, Enhanced Conversions, Customer Match, and unrelated credential collection out of this workflow unless the user separately requests them.
Pin the installer package and the skill source to reviewed versions. Require explicit approval before running the installer.
Confirm the authorized storefront and test order before querying. Use the narrowest available lookup and omit unrelated order details from output.

remediation.issue: Test purchase receipt does not verify order integrity
remediation.suggestion: Document how reported purchases are verified against paid checkout records. Check the authorized test order identifier, value, and payment state before declaring success.

semantic_findings.title: Blanket Cloudflare Permission Approval
semantic_findings.description: The troubleshooting guide tells the user to "approve every permission" without listing the required scopes. The authorization enables a gateway that adds tracking across the selected domain.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The approval instruction and site-wide deployment are explicit. The guide does not specify the actual scopes, so excessive access is possible but not demonstrated.

semantic_findings.title: Browser Handoffs Lack Destination Checks
semantic_findings.description: The agent is told to pass a browser URL from a setup response to the user without checking its origin. An unexpected URL could redirect the user to an unauthorized sign-in or approval page.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The browser handoff is explicit and the instructions omit destination checks. No evidence of a malicious URL was found.

semantic_findings.title: Integration Writes Lack a Separate Approval Step
semantic_findings.description: The workflow directs the agent to apply missing setup steps, including settings that determine what purchase data is sent. Retry safeguards do not require approval for the target account, consent settings, or secondary conversion creation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The rules reserve browser actions and bidding changes for the user. They do not require a separate approval before other setup writes through Product Metrics.

semantic_findings.title: Connection Guides Extend Beyond Google Ads Tracking
semantic_findings.description: The Cloudflare guide lists Meta and ChatGPT Ads in its setup steps. The Google guide includes accepting terms for Enhanced Conversions, which the skill excludes. Following both guides without filtering steps could broaden account access or change data handling beyond the request.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The linked guides contain steps outside the stated scope. No evidence shows that the extra channels or features are enabled automatically.

semantic_findings.title: Purchase Verification Relies on Receipt
semantic_findings.description: The Cloudflare guide says the first report from the confirmation page wins. The test checks receipt and reported value, not whether an authoritative checkout record confirms the purchase. Without independent verification, incorrect purchase data could affect reporting.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The source of the order report and receipt check are documented. No evidence was found in the guide about independent validation by the vendor backend.

content.user_title: Set Up Google Ads Conversion Tracking on Cloudflare
content.value_statement: Browser-based tracking can miss purchases when browser privacy controls or ad blockers limit reporting. Use Product Metrics to configure server-side conversion tracking and check whether a test purchase reaches the collector.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status and identify unfinished steps for the selected storefront.
Guide the Cloudflare gateway connection, the Google Ads client account connection, and the Data Manager approval.
Match the site's supported consent banner to its Product Metrics consent settings.
Guide creation of eight secondary conversion actions and explain cost inputs for profit reporting.
Check for a test purchase and distinguish collector receipt from Google Ads reporting.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, authorized accounts, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and Merchant Center linked to Google Ads.
Users complete browser authorization, account approvals, and changes to primary conversion actions.
Enhanced Conversions, Customer Match, and campaign bidding are outside this workflow.
Consent and confirmation-page reporting affect which purchases are sent. Receipt in Product Metrics does not prove attribution in Google Ads.

use_cases.title: Connect a Cloudflare Storefront
use_cases.description: Identify the account access, Cloudflare gateway, and Google Ads connections needed before running a test purchase.

use_cases.title: Compare Old and New Purchase Actions
use_cases.description: Verify that the new actions are secondary and plan a comparison without changing campaign goals.

use_cases.title: Investigate Missing Purchase Events
use_cases.description: Check the storefront link, consent configuration, event collector, and Google Ads connection to identify the next verification step.

prompt_templates.title: List Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: List the prerequisites for tracking Google Ads purchases on my Cloudflare storefront with Product Metrics. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my authorized storefront and Google Ads client account. List completed steps and any actions that need my approval.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Test Purchase
prompt_templates.prompt: Use only my approved test order to check consent, collector receipt, and Google Ads readiness. Keep unrelated order details out of the response.

prompt_templates.title: Review Conversion Actions Before a Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm whether the eight Product Metrics actions are secondary. Explain how to compare purchase values and check profit inputs without changing campaign goals.

output_examples.input: What remains before I can test purchase tracking?
output: The Cloudflare gateway is complete, and the Google Ads client account is connected.
Data Manager access still needs your approval. Review the request in Google before proceeding.
After approval, verify the consent banner and confirm that the new conversion actions are secondary.

output_examples.input: Did my test purchase reach Google Ads?
output: Product Metrics shows that it received the test purchase. The tracking script and event collector are listed on your domain.
This confirms collector receipt only. Check the secondary actions in Google Ads for conversion reporting.

best_practices: Confirm the exact Cloudflare zone, Google Ads client account, and requested permissions before approving an integration.
Verify the site's consent banner and test one authorized purchase before relying on conversion reports.
Keep new actions secondary during comparison and check profit inputs before using profit values.
anti_patterns: Approving every requested permission or following an unverified sign-in link.
Querying unrelated orders to verify one test purchase.
Treating collector receipt as proof of Google Ads attribution or making both Revenue and Profit primary.

faq.question: What access do I need?
faq.answer: Use a Product Metrics Pro workspace and a Cloudflare account that can approve the storefront zone. Google Ads needs a client account with linked Merchant Center.

faq.question: Do I need to edit code or DNS?
faq.answer: The storefront record must already be proxied. Product Metrics sets up a Cloudflare gateway without editing site code or changing DNS records.

faq.question: Which consent banners are supported?
faq.answer: The guide lists OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, and Osano. Select the banner that the storefront actually uses.

faq.question: Will the new actions affect bidding immediately?
faq.answer: The eight actions start as secondary. Any decision to make an action primary belongs to the account owner.

faq.question: How do I verify a test purchase?
faq.answer: Complete checkout to the order confirmation page. Check Last purchase received in Product Metrics, then review conversion reporting separately in Google Ads.

faq.question: Why are the profit actions empty?
faq.answer: Website order reports do not include product costs. Set a product cost fallback percentage and add the applicable additional costs.
